gallery.summary: Month-to-month duplex with addenda. Termination notice 'by the 15th' (about 15 days), a 35-day claim deadline in the deposit addendum, and a disclosure without the statutory notice.

wrongSeverity.quote: Either party may end this month-to-month tenancy by written notice delivered on or before the fifteenth (15th) day of a month, effective at the end of that month.
